meta.title: pstack Shell Guard
meta.description: Blocks git add -A, git commit -a, and draft PRs; pauses before force-pushes and deploys.

config.shellTools: Tool names whose command argument is checked as a shell command line.
config.protectedBranches: Shared branches where even --force-with-lease pauses for approval.
config.forbidForcePush: Deny every force-push outright instead of asking (babysit playbook).
config.askPatterns: Regular expressions for publish or deploy commands that require approval.
config.denyPatterns: Regular expression deny rules (persisted via settings or /correct).
